note: THE BRUSH (docs/design/WEB_FORGE.md 3.4): density painted over the land, read by the chunk generator (src/world/brush.js -> src/world/chunkgen.js). Paint it in the World Forge's BRUSH tab (web/forge.html) or with the brushPaint command. A stroke is a capsule along pts (usmap metres, the map's own frame) of radius r; v 0..1; op add | sub | set; soft 0..1 is how much of r fades out. Strokes apply in order.

layers.forest: tree stems: 0 none .. 1 a closed wood
layers.canopy: crown size and the share of tall canopy trees (with forest)
layers.ruin: the share of the corridor's buildings left as ruined shells (default: the kit's share)
layers.rad: radiation: poisoned ground, dead trees, glowing seeps, leaking drums
